subject: Red-eye same-day demo request / timezone clarification for ACME Logistics
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta@acme-logistics.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Logistics Scheduling <scheduling@acme-logistics.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 01:07:00 +0000
Subject: Same-day demo? Can you do it at 22:00 BST tonight?

Hi Nikhil,

Apologies for the late ask — we've had an internal shift and the procurement lead can only meet tonight at 22:00 BST (UK time). This is pretty short notice but ACME is very interested in seeing the latency/cost demo and the routing/fallback behavior. Is there any way your team can run a short 30–40 minute demo at that time?

We understand this may be outside normal hours for you; if you can't, could you recommend someone in APAC who could cover or a recording + quick live Q&A at a later time?

I attached a quick agenda and the internal attendee list.

Thanks — Marta
Marta Ruiz
Head of Procurement, Acme Logistics
attachments: acme-demo-agenda.pdf

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@acme-logistics.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Acme Logistics Scheduling <scheduling@acme-logistics.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 01:34:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Same-day demo? Can you do it at 22:00 BST tonight?

Marta — thanks for the note and the agenda. I can lead the demo but 22:00 BST is 17:00 ET / 14:00 PT and would actually be 06:00 SGT (next day) for our APAC infra engineer, Sergio. Two routing items: 1) which timezone are you using in the agenda (you listed BST but one attendee replied with CEST), and 2) do you need the deep-dive on private VPC + KMS (adds 10–15 minutes)?

If you confirm BST and keep it to the platform + latency demo (no deep-dive on KMS), I can do a trimmed 30-minute demo at 22:00 BST. Sergio offered to join asynchronously for the Q&A if needed.

Proposed quick plan: 22:00–22:30 BST demo (platform tour + live tail latency) + optional 22:30–22:45 BST for Q&A where Sergio logs on from Singapore. I've also attached a timezone availability grid I keep for these cross-region requests.

If that works, I'll send an invite (Zoom) and a short checklist for the environment we'll demo (sample dataset, expected sequence lengths, and access perms).

—Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 02:05:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Same-day demo? Can you do it at 22:00 BST tonight?

Forwarding — quick decision needed. Marta asked for same-day at 22:00 BST. Nikhil can lead but we'd prefer engineering in the call for the KV cache/quantization questions. Sergio — can you join the optional Q&A (starts ~22:30 BST)? If that's impossible, please confirm if you can join just the first 10 minutes to validate the demo environment (we can stagger).

We should also confirm the timezone in ACME's attendee list. I've asked ops to verify the attendee locales (UK vs. mainland EU) because DST/CEST vs. BST mix-ups are common right now.

Quick thumbs: if engineering can't make it, we still run the demo but record the Q&A and schedule a follow-up deep-dive within 48 hours. We should avoid canceling — ACME is in late-stage evaluation.

—Lauren
Director, Sales Ops

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 04:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Same-day demo? Can you do it at 22:00 BST tonight?

Lauren / Nikhil — I can join the Q&A from Singapore (06:00 SGT) but would prefer to keep my time boxed. I'll join 22:25–22:45 BST to cover the KV cache and quantization questions. I will prepare two short slides: expected tail latency changes with prefix caching, and quantization profile tradeoffs for r5-like models.

Also: confirm whether Marta's team expects the demo in BST (British Summer Time) or CEST. Small note — UK is on BST now; mainland EU is CEST and is one hour ahead. We've had two no-shows this week because a prospect scheduled for "10:00" but didn't specify timezone.

Sergio
Senior Infra Engineer

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@acme-logistics.com>, Acme Logistics Scheduling <scheduling@acme-logistics.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 08:02:00 +0000
Subject: Confirm: 22:00 BST demo tonight — Zoom link and checklist

Marta — thanks, confirmed 22:00 BST tonight. Zoom invite and calendar event sent (link below). Agenda: 0–5m intros, 5–20m live latency/cost demo, 20–30m routing/fallback + sample workload, 30–45m optional Q&A with engineering. Sergio will join for the Q&A window (22:25–22:45 BST).

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/999888777
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=zoom-red-eye-demo
HubSpot: https://hubspot.example.com/deals/ACME-2025-112

Checklist for ACME: please have a sample prompt set and one test account (read-only) for us to call during the demo. If any attendee is on mainland EU, please note their local time (CEST = BST+1). We will record the session and share the recording + follow-up notes.

See you tonight — appreciate the flexibility on short notice.

—Nikhil
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
attachments: timezone-availability-grid.xlsx
